title: Hand-plotted film density/size curves versus frame number (inverted page)
description: Graph-paper chart scanned upside down showing two curves, one solid and one dotted, plotted against film frame number from 0 to about 130, with a small legend near the top identifying the two traces. Stamped CONFIDENTIAL SECURITY INFORMATION in the corners. Part of a series of film density analyses of an unidentified object.
